g.text: Delta Lake vs custom Spark deduplication

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: We can write deduplication logic manually in Spark SQL, but plain Spark with Parquet is not ideal for financial-grade upserts because

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Parquet files do not natively support row-level MERGE, UPDATE, or DELETE.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Delta Lake is better because it provides transactional operations on data lake storage.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * If transaction_id matches, update or skip

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: * If transaction_id does not match, insert

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This makes retries, replays, and reruns safer because the pipeline does not blindly append duplicate records.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Delta Lake is not only available on Databricks. It can also run on AWS EMR with Spark. However, Databricks gives a more integrated

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: experience with Delta Lake, Auto Loader, optimized streaming, Unity Catalog, jobs, monitoring, and governance.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: If we are using plain EMR with Parquet, deduplication and upserts become more manual. If we use EMR with Delta Lake, we can still use

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: MERGE. Databricks mainly makes this easier to operate at scale.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
